preheader: 34 books reviewed in the British papers this week, fiction and non-fiction, one line each.

books.author: Evan Gershkovich
books.subject: Biography & memoir
books.line: The American reporter wrongly jailed in Russia on spying charges tells the story of his ordeal.
books.why: A reporter caught in a spy case and held in Putin's Russia, told from the inside.

books.book: Killing the Pope: John Paul II and the Last Battle of the Cold War
books.author: Serhii Plokhy
books.subject: History
books.line: Was the 1981 shooting of John Paul II a Soviet plot or the act of a lone gunman?
books.why: A shooting in St Peter's Square and a Cold War mystery over who was really behind it.

books.book: Sleuth Hound: The Case of the Real Sherlock Holmes
books.author: Lindsey Fitzharris
books.subject: Biography & memoir
books.line: The life of Joseph Bell, the surgeon who inspired Sherlock Holmes and pioneered work in forensics and nursing.
books.why: The real man behind Sherlock Holmes, a surgeon with a gift for deduction.

books.book: Emperor of Nothing: The Making of Larry David
books.author: Blake J Harrison
books.subject: Arts & culture
books.line: A study of the comic genius of Larry David and how he was made.
books.why: A singular comic genius and the story of how he was made.

books.author: Dustin Hoffman
books.subject: Biography & memoir
books.line: The star of The Graduate and Rain Man looks back on his life and career at 89.

books.author: Erika Lust
books.subject: Biography & memoir
books.line: Erika Lust's memoir, which raises the question of whether ethical porn is really ethical.

books.author: Mona Chalabi
books.subject: Society & ideas
books.line: A data journalist lays bare her own finances and those of ten people across the wealth spectrum.

books.author: Katharine Birbalsingh
books.subject: Society & ideas
books.line: Britain's strictest head teacher argues that left and right have both got multiculturalism wrong.

books.author: Kathleen Burk
books.subject: Life & leisure
books.line: Eight thousand years of wine, from ancient ritual and royal excess to prohibition and modern tastes.

books.author: Edmund de Waal
books.subject: Arts & culture
books.line: The potter and writer on learning ceramics, set beside his grandmother's letters to the poet Rilke.

books.author: Celia Paul
books.subject: Arts & culture
books.line: The painter's seven weeks in Venice become a meditation on grief, desire, art and solitude.

books.book: Super-Beast: The Mysterious Life of Saki
books.author: Oliver Soden
books.subject: Books & writing
books.line: A brisk biography of HH Munro, the Edwardian satirist who wrote as Saki.

books.author: Kate London
books.subject: Crime & thriller fiction
books.line: A police procedural set in the coalfields around Stoke.
